text.trigger: A player searches with a survivor who is not exiled.
text.vignette: Behind a collapsed shelf, a guitar case still holds a guitar with all six strings. You carry it home, tune it by ear, and wonder whether to play it for the quiet hour or for the morning rush.

options.play-for-the-evening: A quiet song at dusk steadies the colony: morale rises by 1.
options.play-at-dawn: A hopeful song over breakfast: every player rolls one extra action die at the start of next round.
